name: cublas_cublasCcopy_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasCcopy_v2.py. Complex64 strided vector copy y<-x via the real cuBLAS baseline. _random_tensor does not support complex, so x/y are built by gen_inputs as (randn+1j*randn).to(complex64) with sizes size=1+(n-1)*inc taken from the declared shapes. reference mutates y in place and returns it. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
